name: @mux-magic/tools
description: Reusable utilities (file system, logging, rxjs operators) shared between @mux-magic/api and sibling tools like Gallery-Downloader.
//exports: `mux-magic-source` is a PRIVATE condition name and `source` is not. Every `tsx` entry point in this repo passes one of them so that this package loads from `src/`. `source` is a shared convention, so passing it also re-points third-party packages that declare it — `@internationalized/date` resolves to a TypeScript barrel and hands back 2 named exports instead of 63, which broke `radix-vue` and with it the Docker build. A name only this repo uses cannot collide. `source` stays here for outside consumers that already read it.
